records.series_id: macro_china_new_house_price:北京:二手住宅价格指数-同比
records.note: Selected-city existing-home price index via AKShare; Beijing/Shanghai samples help read property stress but do not replace full 70-city details.

records.label: Shanghai Existing Home Prices, YoY
records.series_id: macro_china_new_house_price:上海:二手住宅价格指数-同比
records.note: Selected-city existing-home price index via AKShare; Beijing/Shanghai samples help read property stress but do not replace full 70-city details.

records.label: Household Consumption Growth
records.note: National-accounts household consumption; not directly comparable to retail sales.

records.label: Household Consumption Share
records.note: Useful for rebalancing, but too low-frequency for near-term consumption momentum.

records.label: Retail Sales, YoY
records.note: Monthly retail-sales growth via AKShare's Eastmoney wrapper; retail sales are not the same concept as national-accounts household consumption.

records.label: Consumer Confidence Index
records.series_id: macro_china_xfzxx:消费者信心指数-指数值
records.note: Consumer confidence index via AKShare's Eastmoney wrapper; use alongside retail sales because survey sentiment can diverge from realized spending.

records.label: Consumer Expectations Index
records.series_id: macro_china_xfzxx:消费者预期指数-指数值
records.note: Consumer expectations index via AKShare's Eastmoney wrapper; levels are survey-based and should be read directionally.

records.label: Passenger Vehicle Retail Sales
records.note: Monthly passenger-vehicle retail sales from CPCA via AKShare; useful for durable-goods demand and policy-sensitive consumption, but not an official NBS retail-sales component.

records.label: New Energy Vehicle Retail Sales
records.note: CPCA new-energy passenger-vehicle retail volume via AKShare; strong cross-check on autos, batteries, and household durable demand, but definitions follow CPCA market statistics.

records.label: New Energy Vehicle Retail Share
records.note: CPCA retail-market share of new-energy vehicles; use as a diffusion and substitution gauge, not as a macro consumption aggregate.

records.label: Current Account Balance
records.note: Annual BOP ratio; SAFE quarterly BOP is the preferred higher-frequency source.

records.label: Exports of Goods & Services
records.note: Annual national-accounts goods and services exports; customs monthly goods trade is the preferred high-frequency source.

records.label: Imports of Goods & Services
records.note: Annual national-accounts goods and services imports; customs monthly goods trade is the preferred high-frequency source.

records.label: Trade Openness
records.note: Goods and services trade share of GDP; does not reveal partner/product composition.

records.label: Customs Exports, YoY
records.note: Monthly customs goods export growth via AKShare; this is goods trade and should not be confused with national-accounts goods-and-services exports.

records.label: Customs Imports, YoY
records.note: Monthly customs goods import growth via AKShare; import prices, commodities, and processing-trade swings can distort the real demand signal.

records.label: Customs Exports
records.note: Monthly customs goods exports via AKShare, converted from USD thousand to USD bn; goods-only and not directly comparable to national-accounts exports.

records.label: Customs Imports
records.note: Monthly customs goods imports via AKShare, converted from USD thousand to USD bn; price swings can blur the domestic-demand signal.

records.label: Customs Trade Balance
records.series_id: macro_china_hgjck:当月出口额-金额-当月进口额-金额
records.note: Monthly goods-trade balance derived from AKShare customs export minus import values; not a full current-account balance.

records.label: Passenger Vehicle Exports
records.note: CPCA passenger-vehicle exports provide a timely autos/manufacturing external-demand gauge; not the same as customs total vehicle exports or national-accounts exports.

records.label: Foreign Exchange Reserves
records.note: Annual reserve stock; PBOC releases monthly reserves around the 7th day of the following month.

records.label: FX Reserves
records.note: Monthly reserve table via AKShare, converted from USD 100mn to USD tn; use as a China-native cross-check against IMF IFS/FRED reserve mirrors.

records.label: Gold Reserves
records.note: Monthly gold reserve quantity from AKShare's reserve table; valuation and quantity signals should be separated.

records.label: FX Reserves ex Gold
records.note: Monthly IMF IFS reserves excluding gold via FRED; PBC's native monthly release is still preferred for headline official tracking.

records.label: USD/CNY Central Parity
records.note: Official central parity table; page query is limited to roughly one year at a time.

records.label: EUR/CNY Central Parity
records.note: Official central parity table; page query is limited to roughly one year at a time.

records.label: USD/CNY Spot Rate
records.note: Federal Reserve H.10 spot-rate mirror; use alongside SAFE central parity to separate market spot from official fixing.

records.label: Real Effective Exchange Rate
records.note: BIS CPI-based broad real effective exchange-rate index; basket weights and CPI adjustments differ from bilateral USD/CNY moves.

records.label: Broad Money Growth
records.note: Annual WDI broad-money growth; PBOC monthly M2 is the preferred China-native series.

records.label: Private Credit by Financial Sector
records.note: Broad financial-depth metric; not a substitute for PBOC loan and TSF flows.

records.label: M2 Growth, YoY
records.note: Monthly M2 growth via AKShare's Eastmoney wrapper; prefer PBOC native statistical releases once a stable parser is wired.

records.label: M1 Growth, YoY
records.note: Monthly M1 growth helps track deposit composition and corporate cash-cycle pressure; AKShare schema should be monitored.

records.label: New RMB Loans
records.note: Monthly new RMB loans from AKShare's Eastmoney wrapper, converted from CNY 100mn to CNY tn; not a full TSF-flow substitute.

records.label: Total Social Financing Flow
records.note: Monthly TSF flow via AKShare's Eastmoney wrapper, converted from CNY 100mn to CNY tn; stock, revisions, and component classifications still require PBOC-native checks.

records.label: TSF RMB Loan Component
records.note: RMB loan component inside TSF flow via AKShare; compare with standalone new RMB loans because concepts and included borrowers can differ.

records.label: 1Y Loan Prime Rate
records.note: LPR history from AKShare's Eastmoney wrapper; latest LPR fixing should be cross-checked against the National Interbank Funding Center/PBOC release.

records.label: 5Y Loan Prime Rate
records.note: 5Y LPR is more relevant for mortgage and long-term loan pricing; AKShare is a wrapper, not the primary official release.

records.label: Large Bank RRR
records.note: Event-based required reserve ratio history via AKShare; effective dates and institution buckets should be cross-checked against PBC announcements.

records.label: Small/Mid Bank RRR
records.note: Event-based required reserve ratio history via AKShare; smaller-bank categories have changed over time, so use the series as a policy-easing marker.

records.label: PBC Total Assets
records.source: AKShare / Sina Finance / PBC Balance Sheet
records.note: Monthly monetary-authority balance-sheet total assets via AKShare's Sina wrapper; compare with PBC statistical releases for release-day precision.

records.label: PBC Foreign-Exchange Assets
records.source: AKShare / Sina Finance / PBC Balance Sheet
records.note: PBC foreign-exchange asset item in CNY terms; valuation, FX intervention, and balance-sheet classification effects can all move the series.

records.label: PBC Claims on Depository Corporations
records.source: AKShare / Sina Finance / PBC Balance Sheet
records.note: Claims on other depository corporations help track central-bank liquidity support and relending-style balance-sheet channels, but instrument decomposition still needs PBC-native detail.

records.label: PBC Reserve Money
records.source: AKShare / Sina Finance / PBC Balance Sheet
records.note: Reserve money is the liability-side anchor for base-money liquidity; read with RRR, SHIBOR, and PBC open-market operations.

records.label: 3M Interbank Rate
records.note: OECD/FRED 3-month interbank-rate mirror; not the PBC policy-rate corridor and should be checked against ChinaMoney/SHIBOR for trading use.

records.label: SHIBOR Overnight
records.note: Daily SHIBOR quote via AKShare; use for money-market liquidity stress, while trading use should check the official SHIBOR site.

records.label: SHIBOR 3M
records.note: Daily 3M SHIBOR via AKShare; this improves over monthly OECD/FRED interbank-rate mirrors but remains a wrapper around the source site.

records.label: Share Price Index
records.note: OECD/FRED broad share-price index; useful for domestic risk appetite, but not a substitute for CSI 300/Shanghai Composite market data.

records.label: A-share Market Capitalization
records.series_id: macro_china_stock_market_cap:市价总值-上海+市价总值-深圳
records.note: Shanghai plus Shenzhen market capitalization via AKShare, converted from CNY 100mn to CNY tn; latest incomplete month can have missing market-cap fields and is skipped.

records.label: A-share Trading Value
records.series_id: macro_china_stock_market_cap:成交金额-上海+成交金额-深圳
records.note: Shanghai plus Shenzhen monthly trading value via AKShare; turnover reflects risk appetite and liquidity but is sensitive to trading-day count.

records.label: Shanghai Margin Balance
records.source: AKShare / Shanghai Stock Exchange Margin Data
records.note: Daily Shanghai margin-financing and securities-lending balance via AKShare; use as a leverage/risk-appetite proxy, not a macro credit aggregate.

records.label: Shenzhen Margin Balance
records.source: AKShare / Shenzhen Stock Exchange Margin Data
records.note: Daily Shenzhen margin-financing and securities-lending balance via AKShare; missing lending detail in recent rows does not prevent total-balance tracking.

records.label: CPI Inflation
records.note: Annual CPI; NBS monthly CPI is the preferred tactical inflation series.

records.label: CPI Inflation, YoY
records.note: Monthly CPI YoY via AKShare's Eastmoney wrapper; keep annual WDI CPI for long-run comparability.

records.label: CPI Inflation, MoM
records.note: Monthly CPI MoM via AKShare's Eastmoney wrapper; useful for near-term price momentum but volatile around holidays and food-price shocks.

records.label: Urban CPI, YoY
records.note: Urban CPI YoY via AKShare; compare with rural CPI to separate location mix from broad price pressure.

records.label: Rural CPI, YoY
records.note: Rural CPI YoY via AKShare; food and local service baskets can make it diverge from urban CPI.

records.label: PPI Inflation, YoY
records.note: Monthly producer-price inflation via AKShare's Eastmoney wrapper; energy and upstream commodity cycles can dominate the signal.

records.label: PPI Index
records.note: Monthly PPI index via AKShare; the index level helps cross-check the YoY rate but base-period conventions should be verified before level comparisons.

records.label: Enterprise Goods Prices, YoY
records.note: Enterprise goods price index via AKShare; it is a useful upstream price-pressure gauge and not the same concept as factory-gate PPI.

records.label: Enterprise Agri Goods Prices, YoY
records.note: Enterprise-goods agriculture sub-index via AKShare; read with high-frequency agricultural wholesale indexes for food-price momentum.

records.label: Enterprise Mineral Goods Prices, YoY
records.note: Enterprise-goods mineral sub-index via AKShare; commodity cycles and import prices can dominate the signal.

records.label: Enterprise Coal/Oil/Power Prices, YoY
records.note: Enterprise-goods coal/oil/power sub-index via AKShare; policy pricing and global energy shocks can both move the series.

records.label: Agricultural Wholesale Price Index
records.note: High-frequency agricultural wholesale price index via AKShare; useful as a food-price nowcast, but not a direct CPI food component.

records.label: Commodity Price Index
records.note: High-frequency commodity price index via AKShare; useful for upstream price pressure, but composition and rebasing should be checked before attribution.

records.label: Energy Price Index
records.note: High-frequency energy price index via AKShare; use with enterprise coal/oil/power prices because wholesale market moves may not pass through one-for-one to CPI/PPI.

records.label: GDP Deflator
records.note: Useful for economy-wide nominal/real split, but not a monthly price gauge.

records.label: Unemployment Rate
records.note: ILO-modeled annual rate; China urban surveyed unemployment and youth unemployment have definition breaks.

records.label: Total Population
records.note: Annual population stock; revisions can follow census updates.

records.label: Urban Population Share
records.note: Structural urbanization metric; not a labor-market cycle indicator.

records.label: Working-age Population Share
records.note: Captures demographic pressure but not employment quality or migrant-worker dynamics.

records.label: Crude Birth Rate
records.note: Demographic vital-statistics series; revisions are possible.

records.label: Crude Death Rate
records.note: Demographic vital-statistics series; revisions are possible.

records.label: General Government Balance
records.note: IMF WEO includes estimates/projections; China fiscal analysis should also monitor land sales and off-budget local-government financing.

records.label: Fiscal Revenue YTD, YoY
records.note: Monthly cumulative fiscal revenue growth via AKShare; YTD series is affected by base effects and fiscal calendar timing.

records.label: Tax Receipts YTD
records.note: Cumulative national tax receipts via AKShare, converted from CNY 100mn to CNY tn; not the full general-government revenue envelope.

records.label: Tax Receipts YTD, YoY
records.note: Cumulative tax-receipts growth via AKShare; quarterly/YTD reporting can create mechanical jumps at year boundaries.

records.label: General Government Gross Debt
records.note: IMF WEO measure; does not fully solve quasi-fiscal/LGFV boundary issues.

records.label: Real GDP Growth
records.note: ONS quarter-on-quarter CVM GDP growth is preferred over the slower FRED/OECD mirror; early UK GDP is still subject to material revisions.

records.label: Nominal GDP
records.note: Nominal level is useful for scale and debt ratios, but not for real activity momentum.

records.label: Real Private Consumption
records.note: Quarter-on-quarter growth derived from ONS household final consumption expenditure, national concept CVM SA; revised alongside GDP balancing.

records.label: Real Household Disposable Income per Head
records.note: ONS real household disposable income per head, chained-volume seasonally adjusted; useful for the household purchasing-power channel, but quarterly sector-account revisions can be material.

records.label: Household Saving Ratio
records.note: ONS households and NPISH saving ratio, current-price seasonally adjusted; important for consumption resilience, but can be revised with income, pension-saving, and sector-account balancing updates.

records.label: Real Gross Fixed Capital Formation
records.note: Quarter-on-quarter growth derived from the ONS CVM SA GFCF level; investment is volatile and revision-prone.

records.label: Monthly GDP Index
records.note: ONS monthly GDP index gives release-day activity tracking, but still feeds into later quarterly GDP revisions.

records.label: Industrial Production
records.note: ONS Index of Production, B-E production CVMSA; preferred over the lagged FRED/OECD mirror for UK release work.

records.label: Index of Services
records.note: ONS Index of Services, monthly seasonally adjusted output index; it covers the largest GDP(O) sector but remains revision-prone around Blue Book and monthly GDP balancing.

records.label: Retail Sales Volume Index
records.note: ONS retail sales volume index, all retailers including fuel, seasonally adjusted; this replaces the slower quarterly OECD/FRED retail mirror.

records.label: Consumer Confidence
records.note: Survey-like signal; helpful because UK hard activity data can be revised substantially.

records.label: Composite Leading Indicator
records.note: OECD CLI is not a GS CAI substitute, but it is a reproducible public leading-cycle proxy.

records.label: Real Residential Property Prices
records.note: BIS real residential property price index; smoother and less release-sensitive than Nationwide/Halifax monthly indices.

records.label: Nominal Residential Property Prices
records.note: BIS nominal residential property price index; does not replicate the report's individual house-price vendor indices.

records.label: UK HPI Average Price
records.note: ONS UK HPI average price from the monthly price-statistics workbook; latest months are provisional and the workbook notes warn that revisions can be larger for newer observations.

records.label: UK HPI Annual Change
records.note: ONS UK HPI annual percentage change; provisional recent months should be cross-checked against the UK HPI release when trading housing-sensitive data.

records.label: Residential Property Transactions
records.note: HMRC monthly residential transactions over GBP 40,000, seasonally adjusted; latest months can be provisional and Wales includes estimated recent data from July 2021 onward.

records.label: Non-Residential Property Transactions
records.note: HMRC monthly non-residential transactions over GBP 40,000, seasonally adjusted; useful for commercial-property liquidity but not a valuation series.

records.label: Housing Starts, England SA
records.note: MHCLG Live Table 222, England quarterly seasonally adjusted building-control-reported new-build permanent dwellings; revisions and response-rate/imputation notes matter.

records.label: Housing Completions, England SA
records.note: MHCLG Live Table 222 all completions; quarterly building-control returns can be revised materially and are less comprehensive than annual net-additions statistics.

records.label: Construction Output All Work
records.note: ONS construction all-work chained-volume seasonally adjusted index from the all-work summary CSV; output is Great Britain rather than full UK and can revise with survey response updates.

records.label: Real Exports
records.note: Quarter-on-quarter growth derived from ONS total trade exports CVM SA; use monthly ONS goods balance for higher-frequency external-pressure timing.

records.label: Real Imports
records.note: Quarter-on-quarter growth derived from ONS total trade imports CVM SA; trade contribution can change after GDP revisions.

records.label: Goods Trade Balance
records.note: ONS seasonally adjusted goods-trade balance, balance-of-payments basis, current prices; volatile erratics and later trade revisions matter.

records.label: Total Trade Balance
records.note: ONS total goods-and-services trade balance from UK Economic Accounts; quarterly and non-seasonally adjusted, so use it for BoP-level context rather than monthly trading impulse.

records.label: Current Account Balance
records.note: ONS balance-of-payments current-account balance as a share of GDP; use for external-funding and sterling vulnerability context, not high-frequency trade timing.

records.label: Sterling Real Effective Exchange Rate
records.note: BIS REER is the clean public sterling competitiveness measure used here for the FCI-style FX channel.

records.label: Unemployment Rate
records.note: ONS unemployment rate, aged 16 and over, seasonally adjusted; ONS labels the latest point as a three-month average.

records.label: Employment Total
records.note: ONS number of people in employment aged 16 and over, seasonally adjusted and labelled as a three-month average; LFS sampling uncertainty remains important.

records.label: Employment Rate, Ages 16-64
records.note: ONS employment rate, aged 16-64, seasonally adjusted; ONS labels the latest point as a three-month average.

records.label: Economic Inactivity Rate, Ages 16-64
records.note: ONS LFS economic inactivity rate for ages 16-64, seasonally adjusted and labelled as a rolling three-month average; central for UK labour-supply and wage-pressure analysis, but LFS sampling uncertainty remains important.

records.label: Claimant Count
records.note: ONS UK claimant count, people, seasonally adjusted; definition can be affected by benefit-system changes.

records.label: Job Vacancies
records.note: ONS UK vacancies, total, in thousands; useful as a labour-demand pressure gauge.

records.label: Total Weekly Hours Worked
records.note: LFS total actual weekly hours worked, seasonally adjusted; captures labour input beyond headcount.

records.label: Redundancy Level
records.note: ONS LFS redundancy level, seasonally adjusted and shown as a three-month average; LFS sampling uncertainty and rolling-window labels matter.

records.label: Redundancy Rate
records.note: ONS LFS redundancy rate per 1,000 employees, seasonally adjusted three-month average; read alongside vacancies, unemployment, and claimant count.

records.label: AWE Total Pay Growth
records.note: AWE whole-economy year-on-year three-month-average growth, total pay excluding arrears; bonus swings can distort the series.

records.label: AWE Regular Pay Growth
records.note: AWE whole-economy regular-pay growth, three-month average, excluding arrears; cleaner for domestic wage persistence than total pay.

records.label: PAYE Payrolled Employees
records.note: ONS/HMRC PAYE RTI seasonally adjusted payrolled employees; highly timely administrative labour-market evidence, but provisional early estimates can revise.

records.label: PAYE Employees Monthly Change
records.series_id: ONS RTI SA:Change on previous month
records.note: Monthly change from the ONS/HMRC PAYE RTI workbook; more timely than LFS employment, but can be revised as payroll submissions mature.

records.label: PAYE Median Monthly Pay
records.note: Seasonally adjusted RTI median monthly pay; complements AWE by using PAYE administrative data rather than the Monthly Wages and Salaries Survey.

records.label: PAYE Aggregate Pay
records.note: Seasonally adjusted aggregate PAYE pay, converted to GBP bn per month; useful for household-income nowcasting but sensitive to coverage and revisions.

records.label: PAYE Employee Inflows
records.note: PAYE RTI employee inflows; ONS warns early inflow/outflow estimates have historically revised downward in the following month.

records.label: PAYE Employee Outflows
records.note: PAYE RTI employee outflows; read with the same early-estimate revision caveat as inflows.

records.label: PAYE Median Pay Growth
records.series_id: ONS RTI SA:Median of pay growth
records.note: Median of individual year-on-year pay growth from PAYE RTI, converted from decimal to percent; it only compares individuals employed in both months.

records.label: Headline CPI Inflation
records.note: ONS CPI annual rate, all items; this is the MPC target measure and replaces the lagged FRED/OECD mirror.

records.label: Core CPI Inflation
records.note: Core CPI helps separate domestic persistence from headline energy/import noise.

records.label: CPIH Inflation
records.note: ONS CPIH annual rate including owner occupiers' housing costs; not the MPC target, but important for broad household cost-of-living analysis.

records.label: Owner Occupiers' Housing Costs
records.note: ONS CPIH annual rate for owner occupiers' housing costs; useful for separating the UK housing-cost channel from CPI's target-measure framing.

records.label: CPI Services Inflation
records.note: ONS CPI annual rate for services; a key BoE domestic-persistence gauge and more policy-relevant than headline energy swings.

records.label: CPI Goods Inflation
records.note: ONS CPI annual rate for goods; useful for separating imported goods/supply-chain disinflation from domestic services persistence.

records.label: Food & Non-Alcoholic Beverages CPI
records.note: ONS CPI annual rate for food and non-alcoholic beverages; important for household real-income pressure and inflation-expectations narratives.

records.label: Household Energy CPI
records.note: ONS CPI annual rate for electricity, gas, and other household fuels; dominated by Ofgem price-cap mechanics and base effects, so read alongside services/core CPI.

records.label: RPI Inflation
records.note: ONS RPI all-items 12-month change; not a National Statistic, but still relevant for gilts, contracts, and UK inflation history.

records.label: RPIX Inflation
records.note: Derived year-on-year rate from the ONS RPIX index excluding mortgage interest payments; RPIX is no longer the MPC target but remains useful for historical UK inflation work.

records.label: PPI Output: Manufactured Products
records.note: ONS PPI output total manufactured products excluding duty, index level; use the release table for detailed industry decomposition.

records.label: Petrol Pump Price
records.note: Weekly DESNZ road-fuel pump price for ultra-low-sulphur unleaded petrol; useful for near-term energy CPI pressure but not a substitute for the full CPI fuel component.

records.label: Diesel Pump Price
records.note: Weekly DESNZ road-fuel pump price for ultra-low-sulphur diesel; diesel matters for transport-cost pass-through and can diverge from petrol.

records.label: Bank Rate
records.note: Official BoE Bank Rate via the IADB CSV endpoint; daily rows repeat the prevailing policy setting between MPC decisions.

records.label: SONIA
records.note: Daily Sterling Overnight Index Average; a modern UK money-market benchmark for the overnight rate complex.

records.label: 10Y Nominal Gilt Par Yield
records.note: BoE daily yield from British government securities, 10-year nominal par yield; a cleaner UK-native long-rate channel than the lagged FRED/OECD monthly mirror.

records.label: 5Y Nominal Gilt Par Yield
records.note: BoE daily yield from British government securities, 5-year nominal par yield; useful for reading the belly of the gilt curve alongside Bank Rate, SONIA, and the 10-year yield.

records.label: GBP/USD Spot
records.note: BoE daily spot exchange-rate series; useful for release-day sterling impulse, not a real effective exchange rate.

records.label: Broad Sterling ERI
records.note: BoE monthly average broad sterling exchange-rate index; complements the BIS real exchange-rate series.

records.label: UK Share Prices
records.note: Equity-price channel for a public FCI dashboard; the GS UK FCI used FTSE All-Share and proprietary weights.

records.label: M4 ex Intermediate OFCs Growth
records.note: UK-native broad-money growth from BoE M4 liabilities to private sector excluding intermediate OFCs; cleaner than the OECD/FRED mirror for UK release work.

records.label: M4 Lending Growth
records.note: BoE twelve-month growth of M4 lending to the private sector, seasonally adjusted; captures bank-credit transmission.

records.label: Consumer Credit Growth
records.note: BoE total consumer-credit twelve-month growth excluding Student Loans Company, not seasonally adjusted; definition breaks should be checked around methodology changes.

records.label: Mortgage Approvals for House Purchase
records.note: BoE seasonally adjusted sterling mortgage approvals for house purchase to individuals; a high-signal housing-credit leading indicator.

records.label: Quoted Household Mortgage Rate
records.note: BoE quoted household-rate series from the IADB; useful for mortgage-rate transmission, but confirm the exact product definition before comparing against lender-specific quotes.

records.label: Official Reserves ex Gold
records.note: IMF reserve series via FRED; useful for external liquidity context, not a core UK rates driver.

records.label: PSNB ex Banks
records.note: ONS public sector net borrowing excluding public-sector banks, monthly; volatile month to month and affected by timing of taxes and spending.

records.label: PSNCR ex Banks
records.note: ONS public sector net cash requirement excluding public-sector banks; cash timing can diverge from accrual-based PSNB and should be read alongside borrowing.

records.label: PS Current Receipts ex Banks
records.note: ONS public-sector total current receipts excluding public-sector banks, current-price non-seasonally adjusted; monthly tax timing creates large seasonal patterns.

records.label: PS Current Expenditure ex Banks
records.note: ONS public-sector total current expenditure excluding public-sector banks, current-price non-seasonally adjusted; compare with receipts and PSNB rather than reading one month in isolation.

records.label: Income & Wealth Taxes ex Banks
records.note: ONS public-sector income and wealth taxes excluding public-sector banks; January self-assessment receipts make this series highly seasonal.

records.label: Net Social Benefits Payable
records.note: ONS public-sector net social benefits payable excluding public-sector banks; captures welfare-spending pressure but is non-seasonally adjusted.

records.label: Total Managed Expenditure ex BoE
records.note: ONS total managed expenditure excluding the Bank of England and public-sector banks; useful for fiscal impulse context, but non-seasonally adjusted and affected by classification changes.

records.label: PSND ex Banks
records.note: ONS public sector net debt excluding public-sector banks as a percentage of GDP; conceptually closer to UK fiscal headlines than IMF general-government debt.

records.label: PSNFL ex Banks
records.note: ONS public sector net financial liabilities excluding public-sector banks; broader balance-sheet measure than PSND and sensitive to liquid financial assets and valuation changes.

records.label: PSND ex Banks ex BoE
records.note: ONS PSND excluding public-sector banks and Bank of England as a share of GDP; useful for stripping out BoE balance-sheet distortions around APF and QE.

records.label: OBR PSNB Forecast
records.note: Official OBR EFO public-sector net borrowing forecast by UK financial year; this is a forecast vintage, not an ONS outturn series.

records.label: OBR PSND ex BoE Forecast
records.note: OBR forecast for PSND excluding the Bank of England as a share of GDP; used instead of the workbook's headline PSND formula row because the downloaded cached values require sanity checks.

records.label: OBR CG Debt Interest Forecast
records.note: OBR central-government debt-interest forecast net of APF; highly sensitive to gilt yields, inflation-linked uplift, financing mix, and APF treatment.

records.label: OBR Public-Sector Effective Interest Rate
records.note: OBR effective interest-rate forecast for the public-sector debt stock; useful for debt-service pressure, but it is modelled from the OBR forecast vintage.

records.label: General Government Net Lending/Borrowing
records.note: Annual IMF general-government concept; not the same as monthly PSNB.

records.label: General Government Gross Debt
records.note: Annual IMF debt ratio; the GS guide warns that UK PSND and general-government debt differ by sector boundary and liquid-asset treatment.

records.label: Real GDP Growth
records.note: BEA annualized quarter-on-quarter real GDP growth; advance estimates are revised.

records.label: Real GDP Level
records.note: Chained-dollar real GDP level; useful for scale and cycle depth.

records.label: Nominal GDP Growth
records.note: Derived year-over-year growth from BEA nominal GDP level.

records.label: Personal Income Growth
records.note: Derived year-over-year growth from BEA personal income.

records.label: Real Disposable Income Growth
records.note: Real disposable personal income is central to household spending capacity.

records.label: Corporate Profits Growth
records.note: NIPA corporate profits; not identical to S&P 500 earnings.

records.label: Real PCE Component Growth
records.note: Quarterly real PCE from NIPA; useful for decomposing GDP-side demand.

records.label: Real Private Domestic Investment Growth
records.note: Investment is the cyclical high-beta component of real GDP.

records.label: Real Government Spending & Investment Growth
records.note: Real government consumption and investment; separates fiscal demand from private demand.

records.label: Real Net Exports
records.note: Real net exports level; negative values indicate an external demand drag.

records.label: Private Inventory Change Share of GDP
